infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Projectfeed needs access to your photos so you can attach images to posts and messages.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Projectfeed needs camera access so you can take photos for posts.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Projectfeed uses your location to show places near you and to tag where a note or review was taken. Your location is never shown on your profile.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Projectfeed needs microphone access to record sound with videos.
